decision: Accept the voxel-image-processing porosity pipeline as REAL if (i) random-mask actual porosity matches requested porosity within 15% relative error across φ∈{0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8}, (ii) analytical-geometry porosity from voxelized sphere/cylinder/ellipsoid matches analytical value within 15%, (iii) convergence order p≥1 for porosity error vs resolution, (iv) 3-D random mask porosity within 15%.
stopping_rule: First failing criterion stops promotion; partial pass reported as honest partial.

sensitivity.analysis: Relative error |φ_computed - φ_ref| / φ_ref; convergence via log-log fit of error vs 1/n.

baseline: Analytical porosity for canonical geometries; requested porosity for random masks.
